endpoint.triangulation: All other observations for each held-out endpoint view

policy.threshold_scope: Preregistered pixel budgets, not calibrated accuracy guarantees. Endpoint distance and target-to-finite-segment distance are new diagnostic semantics.

declarations.pairing: One background training/validation and perturbed initial-camera draw per seed, reused by all four rod modes and all target-evidence sets. Full+4 fixed leave-groups require only 100 camera fits.
declarations.endpoint_noise: Identical endpoint/view Gaussian draws in all four modes. Swap endpoints only in view 2 after adding their noise.
declarations.target_claim_noise: Independent RNG stream from endpoint/background measurements; the same two noise vectors are shared across corresponding evidence conditions. Independence refers to noise draws, not independence from latent simulated geometry.
declarations.target_claims: Two points on the requested target; two points on the candidate-consistent target; only the first requested-target point. Clean and endpoint-swap modes have identical requested/candidate target points.
declarations.source_identity: Every view hashes an anonymous measurement bank containing its background tracks, all four rod cases and every raw target-claim set. The bank contains no SHA fields. This is a measurement-bank identity, never an RGB image hash.
declarations.inference: No GT cameras, world points, mode/claim labels, seeds, or physical errors in estimator inputs. Claims cannot refit cameras or rods or choose thresholds.
declarations.initialization: Preregistered synthetic perturbations of latent cameras; not DA3 predictions and not exact-camera initialization.
declarations.annotation: All claims are generated 2D synthetic measurements. No real image, human click study, RGB detection/matching success, or automatic identity recognition is implied.
declarations.evaluation: One full-control camera-only Sim3 per seed reused for all modes/folds. Keep missing conditions; do not promote a fold using physical truth.
declarations.sample_unit: Twenty paired seed replicates of one declared scene family. Eighty rod families and four hundred conditions are correlated, not four hundred independent samples or unseen real objects.
declarations.boundaries: Coherent wrong rods can have small leave-out residuals; candidate-consistent wrong claims can also agree. Missing single-view claims remain unresolved. A passing diagnostic does not certify physical identity.
declarations.freeze: Freeze this protocol, new generator and imported camera_envelope_challenges.py before producing input/truth files. Do not select seeds by outcomes or reroll failures.
